px_scale_note: texture px x px_scale = design px

layers.note: authored 1280 x 260; stretch to the pad-strip rectangle

floor_grid.note: x on the far wall base line; a floor line through far_x at screen row y is at x = vp_x + (far_x - vp_x) * (y - vp_y) / (far_y - vp_y)

stage.pieces_note: pos/size = top-left rectangle in design px; pivot (rotate/sway/flicker) is in design px relative to pos; blend add = draw additively

crack_segment.note: a straight fissure slice: stretch it vertically or chain it end to end

flame_jet.note: pivot at the base centre; animate by flip/scale
